checks.text: The page shows the heading "Medication Reminder" and the text "No medications yet".

Typing "Lisinopril" in the field labelled "Medication name", "10 mg" in "Dose", and "08:00" in "Time", then clicking the button "Add medication" adds a list item in the medication list containing "Lisinopril", "10 mg" and "08:00"; "No medications yet" is gone.
After adding Lisinopril 10 mg 08:00, clicking the button "Log dose" on the Lisinopril item adds an entry with the text "Lisinopril 10 mg taken at 08:00" to the region named "Dose log".

After logging a dose for Lisinopril, clicking the button "Delete Lisinopril" removes the medication from the medication list and the "Dose log" region shows "No doses logged" (deleting a medication also removes its logged doses).

After adding Lisinopril 10 mg 08:00 and logging a dose, clicking the tab "History" shows a table with column headers "Date", "Medication", "Dose" and "Time" and a body row containing "Lisinopril", "10 mg" and "08:00".
With Lisinopril 10 mg 08:00 added, clicking the button "Export CSV" puts this exact text on the clipboard: "Medication,Dose,Time\nLisinopril,10 mg,08:00".
After adding Lisinopril 10 mg 08:00 and then Metformin 500 mg 12:00, the medication list has two items containing "Lisinopril" and "Metformin"; the "Dose log" region shows "No doses logged".
With Lisinopril and Metformin added, typing "Lis" in the field labelled "Search" leaves only the item containing "Lisinopril"; the "Metformin" item is not present.

After adding Lisinopril 10 mg 08:00 and logging a dose, reloading keeps the "Lisinopril" item (with "10 mg" and "08:00") in the medication list and the entry "Lisinopril 10 mg taken at 08:00" in the "Dose log" region.
